notes: Generated award metadata from official prize pages. Deadlines and criteria are time-sensitive; manual curation may override these fields.

award-andrew-carnegie-medal-for-excellen.description: The Andrew Carnegie Medals for Excellence recognize outstanding fiction and nonfiction books for adult readers published in the United States in the previous year.
award-andrew-carnegie-medal-for-excellen.deadline: Committee-nominated; no open public submission deadline surfaced
award-andrew-carnegie-medal-for-excellen.criteria: Adult fiction and nonfiction published in the U.S. in the previous year; longlist, finalists, and winners are selected by library professionals.
award-andrew-carnegie-medal-for-excellen.logoCredit: American Library Association via Wikimedia Commons

award-bancroft-prize.description: The Bancroft Prizes are awarded annually by Columbia University for distinguished works in American history, including biography, and diplomacy.
award-bancroft-prize.criteria: Books must have a copyright date in the previous year and fall under American history, biography, or diplomacy; digital-only books and resubmissions are ineligible.
award-bancroft-prize.prizeAmount: $10,000 to each author, according to the 2026 winners announcement

award-cundill-history-prize.description: The Cundill History Prize recognizes history writing in English that combines historical scholarship, originality, literary quality, and broad appeal.
award-cundill-history-prize.deadline: 2026 submissions closed February 27, 2026; next round expected early 2027
award-cundill-history-prize.criteria: Open to works of historical nonfiction first published in English during the stated eligibility window; translations are welcomed, while self-published books, textbooks, edited collections, posthumous works, and co-authored works are ineligible.
award-cundill-history-prize.prizeAmount: US$75,000 winner prize; US$10,000 for each runner-up
award-cundill-history-prize.logoCredit: Cundill History Prize via Wikimedia Commons

award-kirkus-prize-for-nonfiction.description: The Kirkus Prize honors fiction, nonfiction, and young readers' literature reviewed by Kirkus and selected from starred reviews.
award-kirkus-prize-for-nonfiction.deadline: Automatic eligibility for Kirkus-starred books in the stated publication window; no separate prize-only submission
award-kirkus-prize-for-nonfiction.criteria: Books reviewed by Kirkus Reviews that earn a Kirkus Star and have eligible publication dates are automatically nominated; editors and jurors select finalists and winners.

award-los-angeles-times-book-prize-for-h.description: The Los Angeles Times Book Prizes celebrate books from the previous year across multiple categories, including history.
award-los-angeles-times-book-prize-for-h.criteria: Eligibility generally requires first U.S. publication in English during the prize year; authors, publishers, agents, and publicists cannot submit titles directly.
award-los-angeles-times-book-prize-for-h.prizeAmount: Not prominently sourced on the official FAQ
award-los-angeles-times-book-prize-for-h.logoCredit: Los Angeles Times via Wikimedia Commons

award-mark-lynton-history-prize.organization: Columbia Journalism School and the Nieman Foundation for Journalism at Harvard
award-mark-lynton-history-prize.description: The Mark Lynton History Prize is part of the J. Anthony Lukas Prize Project and recognizes a book-length work of history that combines intellectual distinction with felicity of expression.
award-mark-lynton-history-prize.criteria: Books must have been published in the United States during the applicable calendar year; anyone, including the author, may submit a book.

award-national-book-award-for-nonfiction.description: The National Book Award for Nonfiction is one of the annual National Book Awards recognizing books published by U.S. publishers in the eligibility period.
award-national-book-award-for-nonfiction.deadline: May 13, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. PDT for the 2026 entry form
award-national-book-award-for-nonfiction.criteria: Books must be published by a U.S. publisher within the eligibility period; for nonfiction, authors must meet the National Book Foundation's citizenship or long-term U.S. home requirement.

award-national-book-critics-circle-award.description: The National Book Critics Circle presents annual awards for books published in English across categories including nonfiction.
award-national-book-critics-circle-award.deadline: No formal submission deadline; publishers may bring books to board attention, with early submission encouraged
award-national-book-critics-circle-award.criteria: Eligible books are published in English in the United States during the calendar-year awards cycle; NBCC does not charge fees or accept formal official submissions.
award-national-book-critics-circle-award.prizeAmount: No cash award prominently sourced on the official submissions page
award-national-book-critics-circle-award.logoCredit: National Book Critics Circle via Wikimedia Commons

award-pen-john-kenneth-galbraith-award-f.description: The PEN/John Kenneth Galbraith Award for Nonfiction honors distinguished general nonfiction with literary merit and critical perspective on contemporary issues.
award-pen-john-kenneth-galbraith-award-f.deadline: Annual PEN America literary-awards cycle; see award page for current submission timing
award-pen-john-kenneth-galbraith-award-f.criteria: Eligible books are single-author nonfiction books published in the United States by a trade or academic publisher in the previous calendar year; biographies and self-published books are ineligible.
award-pen-john-kenneth-galbraith-award-f.logoCredit: PEN American Center via Wikimedia Commons

award-pulitzer-prize-in-history.description: The Pulitzer Prize in History recognizes a distinguished and appropriately documented book on the history of the United States.
award-pulitzer-prize-in-history.deadline: October 15, 2026 at 5:30 p.m. Eastern time for 2026-published books
award-pulitzer-prize-in-history.criteria: Books entries are restricted to eligible works first published in the United States during the relevant calendar year and made available in hardcover or bound paperback for public purchase.
award-pulitzer-prize-in-history.logoCredit: Pulitzer medal image via Wikimedia Commons

award-prose-awards.name: PROSE Awards
award-prose-awards.description: The PROSE Awards recognize professional and scholarly works of merit across subject areas including humanities and social sciences.
award-prose-awards.deadline: 2026 entries were accepted from September 22 through November 10, 2025 for 2025-copyright works
award-prose-awards.criteria: Books and nonfiction graphic novels are eligible when submitted by eligible publishers; category winners advance to area awards and the R.R. Hawkins Award.
award-prose-awards.prizeAmount: No cash prize prominently sourced; entry fee was $115 per entry for the 2026 cycle

award-wolfson-history-prize.name: Wolfson History Prize
award-wolfson-history-prize.description: The Wolfson History Prize recognizes outstanding history writing for a general readership, with past winners listed from 1972 onward.
award-wolfson-history-prize.deadline: Annual submission cycle; see official prize site for current dates
award-wolfson-history-prize.criteria: History books are assessed for excellence in historical research and readability for a wider public audience.
award-wolfson-history-prize.prizeAmount: Current prize amount not yet source-normalized

award-phi-beta-kappa-book-awards.name: Phi Beta Kappa Book Awards
award-phi-beta-kappa-book-awards.description: The Phi Beta Kappa Book Awards are given annually to outstanding scholarly books published in the United States and accessible to the general reader.
award-phi-beta-kappa-book-awards.deadline: 2026 nominations closed November 15, 2025; check official page for the next cycle
award-phi-beta-kappa-book-awards.criteria: Publisher-submitted books published in the United States, drawn from humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, and mathematics, must be broad in interest and accessible to general readers.

award-american-historical-association-pu.name: American Historical Association Publication Prizes
award-american-historical-association-pu.description: The American Historical Association awards publication prizes across historical fields, recognizing books and other historical scholarship.
award-american-historical-association-pu.deadline: Annual prize cycle; see AHA prize pages and current calls for deadlines
award-american-historical-association-pu.criteria: AHA publication prizes are field-specific and are awarded for exceptional books and scholarship in defined historical areas.
award-american-historical-association-pu.prizeAmount: Varies by prize; not yet source-normalized
